tags.COMMENT: The composition "Ami" derives from the French word ami for "friend". The song's naming was also inspired by 1986 novel by Chilean writer Enrique Barrios, entitled "Ami, el niño de las estrellas"

The theme of Chocobo World, also plays on a road in Winhill where the chicobo appears.
The title is a pun on the traditional "de" used in Chocobo Theme titles, and "odekake" which means "going out" in Japanese.
